name: Glabrezu
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The glabrezu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic. 1/Day Each: Confusion, Fly (self only), Power Word Stun.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

description: Glabrezu are cunning, four-armed demons who tempt mortals with wishes and magic granted through Spellcasting, only to crush any deal-breaker in their crushing pincers once the bargain sours.
